data.narrative:
NODA AI is a Series A-stage defense and security company founded by Philong Duong and Dave Corbett. The valuation analysis draws on a comparables universe of 10 same-sector, same- and adjacent-stage peers, comprised of 8 private and 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS). Key private comparables include Stark Defence, Singularity, Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Shield AI.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier to NODA's last post-money valuation of $125M, implying $250M. Peer-median analysis across the 10-company comparables set yields a median valuation of $1.0B, with a range spanning $300M to $4.0B. The peer sample includes Stark Defence at $4.0B (Series A), Dream Security at $3.0B (Series B), Harmattan AI at $1.4B (Series B), Code Metal at $1.2B (Series B), and Castelion at $1.0B (Series B).

Triangulation of these two methods supports a valuation range of $212M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $625M. The current $125M post-money reflects early-stage funding totaling $29M to date. Key uncertainties include heterogeneity within the peer set—particularly the wide $300M-to-$4.0B range—and stage-progression methodology sensitivity to assumed step-up multiples. The peer-median approach carries material weight given robust sample size, though application across adjacent stages introduces some comparability risk.
